quote: On a persistent browser after upgrade, this filter excludes those still-open tabs unless the session transcript references them, so an existing session panel can appear to lose its tabs.
note: The earlier P1 finding says the session filter hides untracked tabs, which is the mechanism behind the bug, but it is about pre-upgrade panel tabs, not the focus page's fixed startup tab sent with an empty reference list. steipete accepted it as intended and the at-merge version listed no findings.
